caseReviews.rationale: The official gamebook confirms Smith inactive and lists Arnold Ebiketie, A.J. Epenesa and elevated Keyshawn James-Newby as active edge substitutes behind the Greenard/Hunt starting edge pair.
caseReviews.roleRationale: The final gamebook establishes the complete three-player active substitute edge candidate set, but it does not print their exact added-duty allocation.
caseReviews.assumptionRationale: Use the approved equal-share committee only for Smith's additional vacant edge duty; this is a labelled allocation assumption, not observed snap weights.
caseReviews.baselineRationale: Greenard and Hunt remain common starters. Ebiketie, Epenesa and James-Newby retain their existing baseline duties and receive only equal shares of Smith's additional vacancy; no candidate is reused by another resolved case in this bundle.

blockers.finding: The official gamebook is now captured and the complete paired starter, substitute, DNP, inactive, quarterback, specialist and printed injury sequence is assembled. Sixteen explicit personnel cases still require governed numerical role/value reconciliation; Nolan Smith Jr. is retained as a validated labelled case estimate.
blockers.footballImpact: Receiver/return, secondary, edge, running-back, line and reserve-depth effects can change the paired injury loss.
blockers.nextAction: Resolve the listed cases through the approved immutable-value and documented primary/committee owners, preserving disjoint duties and roster-exit exclusions, then evaluate both teams together.

blockers.finding: Quinyon Mitchell has a complete printed injury-to-return interval. Covey and Barkley lack printed initial exit plays; Pierce and Ojomo have printed exits but no return notices.
blockers.footballImpact: Arbitrary exposure can materially distort Philadelphia return, secondary, running-back and defensive-line loss.
blockers.nextAction: Apply the complete Mitchell interval; use only an eligible approved bounded method or source-supported departure/return evidence for the other four cases, otherwise retain unknown exposure.

blockers.finding: All prior supported cases remain retained; the listed sixteen cases still lack a complete, nonduplicated governed value/replacement assignment. Missing values are not zero.
blockers.footballImpact: The unresolved assignments prevent a defensible paired injury-loss subtotal and therefore block Walters arithmetic and publication.
blockers.nextAction: Use already approved source-supported estimates where eligible; route only residual immutable identity/value or method decisions to their existing owners. Do not infer defensive duty from special teams alone.
